title: Use Seedance 2.0 Fast without a storyboard in CapCut.
content:
Use Seedance 2.0 Fast without a storyboard in CapCut.  
Combine Midjourney V7 (for reference images) + GPT-2 in ChatGPT (to generate a Chinese Seedance prompt).  
In the prompt, attach multiple reference images with @image1(...) + @image2(...) to define multiple characters in one scene.  
Add 完全依照该参考图呈现 and 不进行任何重新设计 in each @image block to force strict adherence to the reference image (no redesign).
